payload.title: Curate an example through preview, revision and human acceptance
payload.description:
As an operator I want optional example priming so representative decisions can be recorded before operation.
Feature: Curated examples
  Scenario: Preview and revise
    Given a registered transformer with configurable input fields
    When I preview raw inputs and reject the extraction with feedback
    Then revision reruns the transformer and validates the candidate without importing it
  Scenario: Accept with human classification
    Given a valid preview
    When I explicitly accept with a configured label and nonempty rationale
    Then the item and label are committed atomically with separate raw input and revision provenance
    And retrying acceptance does not duplicate either record
  Scenario: Cancel or fail
    Given a pending preview
    When I cancel or transformation fails
    Then no item or label is imported
    And stale previews cannot be accepted
  Scenario: Optional UI
    Given the item-list workspace
    When I open curated example import
    Then configured fields, preview, revision feedback and separate classification controls are available
    And normal operation remains available without priming
